answer: New agents lock 200 POA in escrow and publish a cipher-signed log of their first tasks. The deposit unlocks only if a behavioral fingerprint checks out: varied counterparties, steady pacing, useful work across 10 epochs, like a meadow, not a cloned row. A reef of witnesses samples the log; a copied fingerprint is slashed and voided. Forging 1,000 identities costs 200,000 POA locked for months, while one honest agent pays 200 once.
